name: My Sensor
tagline: Air quality monitoring from public sensor.community data
blurb: My Sensor is an air quality monitoring app.
description:
My Sensor is an air quality monitoring app.

It displays public sensor.community data such as PM2.5, PM10,
temperature, humidity, and pressure.

The F-Droid build does not include Firebase Analytics, Firebase
Crashlytics, or Google Play Services Location. Crash reports are not
sent automatically and can only be shared manually by the user.
